hook: Your boat glides under a sky of living lights.
title: Your boat sails under a ceiling of stars
description:
The Waitomo Caves in New Zealand look like a night sky, but the lights are glowing larvae hanging from the cave roof. They glow to lure insects into sticky silk threads. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #NewZealand #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you ride this boat? Yes or no
